name: com.carloanmath/car-loan-math
title: CarLoanMath
description: US car loan math: monthly payment, compare loans, max price for your budget, amortization. Free.

tools.name: calculate_auto_loan
tools.description: Monthly payment, amount financed, total interest and total cost for one US car loan. Amount financed = price − down − trade-in + owed on trade-in; sales tax and fees are paid upfront unless tax_and_fees_financed is true, then they are added to the loan. total_cost = cash due at purchase + all payments (price + tax + fees + interest − trade-in + owed). Returns the inputs echoed back and a carloanmath.com share_url. When optional inputs are omitted, the result includes assumed_defaults (the values actually used) and a short text line so you can call again with those parameters. assumed_defaults is omitted when every optional input was provided. Only for US car loans in US dollars: pass country "US" and currency "USD". Do not call this tool for a loan in any other country or currency (for example the UK, £/GBP or €/EUR); tell the user that only US car loans in USD are supported.

country.description: Country of the purchase, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Must be "US": only US car loans in USD are supported.

currency.description: Currency of every amount, ISO 4217. Must be "USD": only US car loans in USD are supported.

price.description: Vehicle price in USD (before tax, fees, down payment and trade-in).

down.description: Cash down payment in USD. Default 0.

trade_in.description: Trade-in value in USD credited against the price. Default 0.

owed_on_trade_in.description: Loan balance still owed on the trade-in, rolled into the new loan (negative equity). Default 0.

apr.description: Yearly interest rate in percent, compounded monthly (the same number as the site’s rate field), e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%. A lender’s APR can be a little higher because it folds in some fees. Use 0 for 0% financing.

sales_tax_rate.description: Sales tax in percent of the vehicle price, e.g. 7 for 7%. No state rules or trade-in tax credit are applied. Default 0.

fees.description: Title, registration, documentation and dealer fees in USD. Default 0.

tax_and_fees_financed.description: false (default, the site's "Pay upfront"): sales tax and fees are paid in cash at purchase, not financed. true: they are added to the loan.

tools.name: compare_auto_loans
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–4 loan scenarios (e.g. 60 vs 72 months, dealer vs credit-union APR, more down). Each result has a share_url; differences are against the first scenario, plus which is cheapest overall and lowest monthly. When optional inputs are omitted, the result includes assumed_defaults (the values actually used) and a short text line so you can call again with those parameters. assumed_defaults is omitted when every optional input was provided. On this tool, assumed_defaults is per scenario. Only for US car loans in US dollars: pass country "US" and currency "USD". Do not call this tool for a loan in any other country or currency (for example the UK, £/GBP or €/EUR); tell the user that only US car loans in USD are supported.

tools.name: max_vehicle_price_for_budget
tools.description: Reverse calculation: the highest vehicle price whose monthly payment stays within monthly_budget, for one or more terms. Uses the same tax, fee, down payment and trade-in rules as calculate_auto_loan. Each row includes the check calculation and its share_url. When optional inputs are omitted, the result includes assumed_defaults (the values actually used) and a short text line so you can call again with those parameters. assumed_defaults is omitted when every optional input was provided. Only for US car loans in US dollars: pass country "US" and currency "USD". Do not call this tool for a loan in any other country or currency (for example the UK, £/GBP or €/EUR); tell the user that only US car loans in USD are supported.
